image_description: A close-up, cropped view of two vertical traffic light units positioned side-by-side. The unit on the left shows an illuminated green light at the bottom and a dark lens above it. The unit on the right shows an illuminated amber/yellow light at the top and a dark lens below it. Both units feature black housings with prominent visors over each lens. The background is completely blown out to white, suggesting high contrast or overexposure.
